Vadodara, October 26th, 2026: Sudeep Pharma Limited (NSE: SUDEEPPHRM, BSE: 544619), a leading manufacturer of pharmaceutical excipients, food and nutrition ingredients and specialty mineral-based solutions, today announced that its new pharma greenfield manufacturing facility at 179 Nandesari, Gujarat, has received approval from the Gujarat Food and Drug Control Administration (FDA), authorising the Company to commence manufacturing operations at the site. The approval marks a significant milestone in the Company's growth journey and confirms that the facility's manufacturing systems, quality controls and compliance framework meet the requirements for commencing manufacturing operations. It reinforces the Company's commitment to strengthening manufacturing capabilities, quality standards and regulatory compliance. Commercial supplies from this facility are expected to commence in H2 FY27, following the completion of customer qualification processes.
